independentReview.scope: Independent exact-integer matrix-wave review of six existing ordinary rounds; no gameplay/model/controller execution.
method: Initialize literal maps/fuel/AP from the public contract. Replay only already-accepted cut/view receipts; navigation is not re-simulated.
At each numbered fire wave, use a geometry/wind matrix whose rows are targets and columns are old sources; multiply by the old burning indicator before changing any cell.
Apply old-source fuel consumption separately from target heat/ignition. Compare complete matrices, uncapped contributions, unique change maps, AP/fuel/forest identities and first terminal priority.
Compare all full initial/final/retained/event/operation states. Preserve lastWave between waves; integer assertions use no numerical tolerance.
limitations: Original raw hashes are provenance from the approved public projection index; diagnostic/private route bytes are not inspected.
Actual coverage counters describe only these six rounds. Two synthetic hand fixtures validate the oracle and do not establish production boundary coverage.
This is a wave-rule and receipt review, not a full input/runtime implementation; no pause/retry/cancel/subtick or post-terminal freeze claim.
Unspecified array order is normalized for wave contribution edges, change IDs and result ID sets, while duplicates remain failures.

candidateNormalPlay.eventScope: Trace contains only actual public observations. Waves or transient events missed between observations are not fabricated; permanent clear receipts, the last actual wave and forest/fuel/AP ledgers remain available. All fire steps are retained in the separate ordinary six-round corpus.

failedAttempt.error: Error: An issued ordinary input was not observed
failedAttempt.scope: Initial observations do not uniquely distinguish a missed neutral interval from the second Down pulse. No physical-rule failure is inferred.

captureDriverWindow.scope: Only the approved second recording and its post-capture checks use this separately tracked recorder. Same public model/pilot, ordinary input, 80ms polling, no state/clock writes.

actualDispatchBarrier.scope: Each actual automatic key change is followed by its saved post-dispatch snapshot; the next executed pilot decision observes a later model tick.

gameRules.scope: Finite clearing AP, integer simultaneous fire waves, changing wind and fixed-denominator forest preservation. Independent offline matrix review consumes the six actual public rounds. Release checks are not independent review by the game designer.

modelTests.scope: Directed model rule and input tests. Any synthetic fixtures are explicitly labelled in the test source. This is not browser, ordinary full-round, or physical-device evidence.

checks.name: P freezes gameplay state and tick, P resumes
R restarts with clean simulation state
resizing keeps canvas and complete sidebar text visible
no page, console or resource errors
three menus expose their public board, AP, fixed forest denominator and weather with no played waves
held START begins once and an invalid held A on the actual ignition is rejected once without AP cost
held phone A and native Enter each clear exactly one cell; empty AP rejects a further standing-cell clear
B changes only the heat display while time runs; P freezes the complete real model until resumed
connected cancellation suppresses stale A/B and neutral release re-arms one physical clear
disconnect freezes the real fire clock and explicit START resume clears stale held navigation
ordinary remote clear choices spend real AP and naturally fail the fixed forest preservation floor
R restores the authored forest, AP, fuel and weather before the next ordinary fire step
separate QR room-info layout fixture fits complete text at both TV sizes

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryFireManagement.scope: Actual key edges, saved last operations/waves and permanent clear receipts. Sparse recording samples do not imply that every wave or transient operation was observed; missing entries are not reconstructed. The separate ordinary corpus retains every actual wave boundary.

finalDriverWindow.scope: Original pre-check driver window remains unchanged. The successful recording uses the separate captureDriverWindow documented in captureHistory; this game's first failure is preserved there.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
